issue.title: Log Recall: Ctrl+N/P phrase history for Schedule, Work, Rotten, and Cancel Log prompts
issue.description: Every free-text prompt in Obsidian and Bob Mac Capture that writes a Schedule, Work, Rotten, or Cancel Log entry can reuse a reason typed earlier for any task in two keystrokes. Ctrl+N/P move through a visible "USED BEFORE" band that is filtered by the draft and ranked by recent and frequent use. The band fills the field, and Enter still writes exactly the text the field shows. The four histories are derived read-only from the vault by `bob logs list`, so they need no new store, have no cold start, and pick up note edits and deletions on their own.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202611/log_reason_recall.md requests this work

issue.title: bob-cli: vault-derived log phrase catalog and `bob logs list`
issue.description: logs-catalog: add a cached scanner over task Schedule, Work, Rotten, and Cancel Logs. It filters out machine-written text using a classifier backed by a writer registry test, then ranks by tiered literal match plus newest-pinned frecency. It ships the read-only `bob logs list` (human and JSON output), the shared rank vectors, and the docs/log-recall.md contract.
